title: A Wedding in the Rain
sentences: My cousin planned her wedding for a Saturday in June.
Everything was to happen outdoors, in her parents' garden.
It rained from early morning until the middle of the afternoon.
Her father spent two hours putting up a borrowed tent.
Half the guests stood on wet grass in their best shoes.
My cousin refused to look upset, which impressed everybody.
The photographs are full of umbrellas and bright faces.
By evening the sky had cleared completely.
People danced outside until well after midnight.
Everyone now says it was the most memorable wedding they have been to.
